headline: 1 of 2,007 catalogued work units produced the artifact it declared. The catalog is an orphaned plan: it carries no execution-state field and its 2,007 declared output paths intersect the program's own ARTIFACT-MANIFEST in 0 places, so plan and delivery cannot be reconciled by anything in the repo. Separately, the entire platform/ tree has zero CI on any OS, and the suite fails 24 tests on Linux.

questions.question: what files were never read
questions.finding: No transcript read-ledger was built (that is BLD-0001's method). Reported as NOT-CHECKED rather than approximated: a proxy would be indistinguishable from the real answer while being wrong. Structural facts only: the corpus holds 610 tracked files and the spec restricts reading to lines 10473-11437 of an ~11,400-line document, so ~90% of the governing prompt is out of declared scope by construction.

questions.question: what clients were never tested
questions.finding: Exactly one client is exercised: claude-code (12 token occurrences) plus a single antigravity reference. Codex/OpenAI is a first-class vendor throughout the program but is not a tested install target. min_client/max_client semver gating exists at platform/plugin/schemas.py:709-710 with no non-claude-code test. Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, Continue, Copilot: zero references.

questions.question: what platforms were never tested
questions.finding: platform/ has ZERO CI on any OS (0 hits across 7 workflow files; positive control command-center=5, monitorcore=22, mcpctl=28). All 13 CI jobs are ubuntu-latest, no matrix. macOS never exercised by any route despite being in the plugin platforms enum. Measured on Linux by this unit: 24 failed / 3875 passed / 37 skipped vs Windows 0 / 3847 / 14; 22 of 24 failures in platform/routing, root-caused to the live ~/.claude coupling.

questions.question: what owner requirements disappeared
questions.finding: All three owner-input slots in the governing spec are still literal placeholders (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10516 option IDs, :10520 overrides, :10524 release mode) and all 27 owner questions are OPEN (OWNER-DECISIONS.md:5). OQ-3 (release mode) is open with 'Phase 15 branches entirely on it', so the brief's 'PR-ONLY is binding' is an EXECUTOR assumption with no owner decision record. OQ-4 asks whether the scope substitution was ever approved: 'No approval record exists anywhere I searched.'

questions.question: what option IDs were silently dropped
questions.finding: None newly. OPTION-ID-RESOLUTION.json measured 283 options with MD/JSON symmetric difference 0, zero title mismatches, and 70 owner-decided in exact agreement across three encodings; the historic 31-way M-NN collision was re-prefixed to MECH-NN. The live gap is not dropped IDs but that OQ-1 was never answered, so no option ID was ever SELECTED.

questions.question: what failures were normalized away
questions.finding: 488 suppression constructs over 355 in-scope deliverable files, 13 regex patterns each proven on a known-positive and a known-negative line first. Largest classes: 112 '# pragma: no cover', 33 pytest.skip() absence guards, 16 '|| true'. TWO OF MY OWN COUNTS WERE CORRECTED DOWNWARD: the except-clause pattern matched 290 lines but only 29 are true swallows (body pass/.../continue), and continue-on-error matched 3 of which 2 are inside YAML comments, leaving exactly 1 live (routing-benchmark.yml:96, self-labelled shadow).

questions.question: what unknowns remain
questions.finding: 13 unknowns (U-1..U-13) on UNKNOWNS-REGISTER.md, none retired; each names its settling experiment. Load-bearing: U-4 (only 7 of 46 failure classes seeded), U-8 (everything marked [inherited] was never re-probed by its own author), U-13 (live vs repo harness never compared). Beyond the register: Phase 13's own contracted artifact did not exist - blindspot-register, contradiction-register and prior-art-register schemas all ship with ZERO instances repo-wide. This unit emits the first blindspot-register instance.

questions.question: what existing work was ignored
questions.finding: The repo already holds the disposition machinery the 2,007 units never used: tools/command-center/close.py + render.py, whose generated header at OWNER-DECISIONS.md:1 states dispositions are closed by running close.py and re-rendering. The 103-item register uses it; the 2,007-unit catalog does not, hence zero receipts and no disposition field. Also ignored: the declared target itself (target 2048, count 2007, shortfall 41, never closed) and hooks/semantic-router, the pre-existing router that CI still gates instead of platform/routing.

questions.question: what test could falsely pass
questions.finding: Latent, not live. The dominant shape is absence-is-not-failure: test_catalog_conformance.py:33-34 'if not CATALOG.is_file(): pytest.skip(...)' carrying '# pragma: no cover'. 33 such guards exist. Correctly scoped: NONE currently fire - a targeted run of the guarded modules gave 221 passed / 0 skipped. The risk compounds with Q03: the guard branch is invisible to coverage and platform/ has no CI, so a deletion flipping 100+ conformance tests from PASS to SKIP would be caught by nothing. My first proof attempt returned masks_found=0, which was a DETECTOR FAILURE (platform/ shadows the stdlib platform module), pivoted per AGENTS.md 4b rather than attempted a third time.

questions.question: what threat actor was not modeled
questions.finding: No STRIDE threat-model artifact exists: every STRIDE hit is a catalog declaration. All 14 spec-required phase-12 refuter lenses are unexecuted (phase 12: 129 catalogued / 0 produced; command-center/adversarial/ does not exist), including the 'cross-platform behavior' refuter that would have caught the Linux failures. The unmodeled actor with a live counterpart already found by a sibling lane is the malicious/compromised publisher plus stale mirror (two CONFIRMED revocation escapes). The actor I judge least modeled is the operator's own fan-out, which the catalog itself flags: 'a threat model that excludes the operator's own fan-out is incomplete by construction'.

questions.question: what would break at 10x scale
questions.finding: Structural facts read, no load test run (NOT-CHECKED). (1) The catalog is a 5.36 MB single JSON blob json.loads'd whole by the conformance tests, schema resolver, authorization gate and renderer; at 10x that is ~54 MB per invocation with no index, no streaming, no pagination. (2) platform/ shadows the stdlib platform module - proven, not inferred, by 'No module named platform.lib; platform is not a package' - survivable only because no __init__.py exists. (3) Wall-clock is already binding: ~211s on Windows, and with zero CI nobody will run it by hand at 10x. (4) A hard-killed plugin install wedges the prefix for 1 hour (sibling finding), which dominates at 10x install concurrency.
